content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD wavemaker module for time-dependent 2D wave spectra (MODULE TIME_SPECTRA_MODULE @L71; header L46, history 01/10/2024 Fengyan Shi L49; call-flow comment L51-66 documents coupling with io.F/main.F/mod_tide.F/sponge.F and WaveMaker='TIME_SPECTRA'). TIME_SPECTRA_INITIAL (L108-272): reads mandatory SPECTRA_FILE from input.txt (L135; missing -> STOP L142/L145), opens it on unit 400 (L159-160), reads title, NumFreq/NumDir (L175), allocates spectral arrays Amp_Ser/AmpData1/AmpData2/Per_Ser/Theta_Ser/Phase_LEFT/Segma_Ser/Wave_Number_Ser/Theta_2D and 3D Cm/Sm arrays (L176-183); reads frequency bins as frequencies then inverts to periods Per_Ser(J)=1/Per_Ser(J) (L192-193); reads direction bins converting deg->rad (L202-203); reads Phase_Data flag (L211): if 1 reads phase matrix and converts with hardcoded 3.1415926/180 (L214-218), else assigns random phases rand()*2*3.1415926 (INTEL/CRAY rand(), generic rand(0), L226-230); reads first spectra time/file (L243-244), sets level 1 = level 2 (L246-247), and reads first amplitude table AmpData2(J,I) rows per direction from unit 401 (L260-269). TIME_SPECTRA_PROTECTION (L274-314): STOPs unless TIDAL_BC_GEN_ABS is set (L282-296) and TideBcType(1:4)=='DATA' (L298-312). TIME_SPECTRA_INTERPOLATION (L316-405): when TIME passes both bracket times shifts level 2 to 1 (L327-329), reads next TimeSpectra2/NameSpectra2 from unit 400 (L333-337; EOF IOstatus<0 GOTO 120 @L335 -> label L379) and next amplitude table from unit 401 (L352-357); computes linear time weights tmp2=(TimeSpectra2-TIME)/MAX(SMALL,|TimeSpectra2-TimeSpectra1|), tmp1=1-tmp2 (L371-373), blends Amp_Ser=AmpData2*tmp1+AmpData1*tmp2 (L377); sets wavemaker depth Dep_Ser=TideWest_ETA+Depth(1,1) (L381) and calls CALCULATE_DATA2D_Cm_Sm_TIME (L383). CALCULATE_DATA2D_Cm_Sm_TIME (L407-535): once (guarded by SAVEd local Not_done_wavenumber L416,L420-421) computes Segma_Ser=2*pi/Per_Ser (L423), initial shallow-water guess Wave_Number_Ser=2*pi/(sqrt(Grav*Dep_Ser)*Per_Ser) (L424-426), then Newton iteration on linear dispersion Fk=Grav*k*tanh(k*d)-sigma**2 (L429), Fkdif derivative (L431-432), update k=k-Fk/Fkdif (L433), converging to |Fk|<=1.0e-8 or 1000 iterations (L430, goto 55/65 loop); once (Not_done_periodic) maps directions for periodic domains via CalcPeriodicTheta into Theta_2D (L442-454); then zeroes Cm/Sm arrays (L460-465), sets Zlev=ABS(1.0+Beta_ref)*Dep_Ser (L467) and accumulates over all freq/dir components the phase-resolved cosine/sine transforms at each grid point: X_maker/Y_maker from global index offsets (PARALLEL iista/jjsta L478-482, serial L488-492), Cm_eta+=Amp_Ser*COS(k*sin(theta)*y + k*cos(theta)*x + phase) (L497-499), Sm_eta with SIN (L500-502), and velocity transfer Segma*cosh(k*Zlev)/sinh(k*Dep_Ser) times COS(theta) or SIN(theta) for Cm_u/Cm_v/Sm_u/Sm_v (L503-526).
entities: CALCULATE_DATA2D_Cm_Sm_TIME locals: Iter,KK,K,KKK @L410, Celerity,Wave_Length,Fk,Fkdif,Zlev,Fact,X_maker,Y_maker @L411, tmp_eta,tmp_u,tmp_v @L414, Theta_Per @L415, Not_done_wavenumber,Not_done_periodic @L416

equations.ref: frequency-to-period inversion, comment L192 'read in as frequency'
random phases, generic branch; rand() for INTEL @L226 / CRAY @L228
wavemaker reference depth incl. west tide level

continuations L498-499: Wave_Number_Ser(KK)*SIN(Theta_2D(KK,KKK))*Y_maker + Wave_Number_Ser(KK)*COS(Theta_2D(KK,KKK))*X_maker + Phase_LEFT(KK,KKK); Sm_eta @L500, Cm_u @L503, Cm_v @L509, Sm_u @L515, Sm_v @L521 with Segma_Ser(KK)*cosh(Wave_Number_Ser(KK)*Zlev)/sinh(Wave_Number_Ser(KK)*Dep_Ser) directional transfer

calls: intrinsics: tanh @L429,L431; sqrt @L424; abs @L430; COS/SIN @L497-526; cosh/sinh @L504-505; TRIM @L261,L352; MAX/ABS @L372

verbatim_spans.text: !  mod_time_spectra.F is a wavemaker module for time-dependent spectra
120 CONTINUE  ! no more data for vessel Kves

unresolved: Cross-line index bug: in the Not_done_periodic block the loop runs DO KK=1,NumFreq (L444) but assigns Theta_2D(I,KKK) (L448 and L450) using I - I is a module/global integer left at NumFreq+1 by the earlier DO I=1,NumFreq loop (L422), so only one row of Theta_2D is written while the Cm/Sm superposition reads Theta_2D(KK,KKK) (L497-526)
Comment @L121 'read precipitation from input.txt' and label comment @L379 'no more data for vessel Kves' are copied from mod_precipitation.F/vessel context, not this module
Dep_Ser @L381 uses Depth(1,1) - a per-rank local corner value (ghost cell) that differs across MPI ranks, combined with only TideWest_ETA even though four tide boundaries exist in TIDE_MODULE
Hardcoded literal 3.1415926 used for phase conversions (L218, L226-230) while PI is available from GLOBAL (used @L203, L423)

One-time initialization relies on implicit SAVE of initialized locals Not_done_wavenumber/Not_done_periodic (L416) - wavenumbers and periodic angles are never recomputed even though Dep_Ser changes with tide level each call (dispersion solved once with the initial Dep_Ser)
Random phases (Phase_Data /= 1) are generated per rank with rand() without explicit seeding - PARALLEL ranks may generate different phase sets; no MPI broadcast in this file

Unused declarations: SpectraName @L118, rII,rJJ @L321, ierr @L320 (INTERPOLATION), tmp_eta,tmp_u,tmp_v @L414, K @L410, PHASE_DATA case variant of Phase_Data (same variable), commented Ein2D/Din2D/Uin2D/Vin2D @L412-413; Stokes_Drift_Ser zeroed @L456 but never computed; Fact set @L457 but never used; Celerity/Wave_Length only used for the initial guess (L424-426, final recompute @L437 unused afterwards)
TIME_SPECTRA_PROTECTION message inconsistency: parallel log says 'TideBcType = DATA' @L303 while stdout/serial say only 'TideBcType' @L304/L308-309

Unit 400 remains open across the run for sequential spectra-schedule reads (L331-337) - same unit number convention as mod_precipitation.F rainfall schedule; both modules would collide if enabled together
